task.title: How to Create The Awards Slideshow
task.shortdesc: Once every event has been graded, it's time for Awards!

context.p: Duosmium offers a tool that generates a slideshow for you. Here's how to get it!

step.cmd: Click the "Results" tab in the toolbar
Ensure that the Publishing Status has no issues.
Make sure all events are selected.
Click the yellow "Generate Slides" button to preview what the slideshow will look like.
Click the yellow "Present" button next to "Generate Slides"
Click the yellow "Resume Presenting" or the yellow "Stop Presenting" button to either resume or stop.
